fee_notes: Royalty is 5% of Net Sales, paid weekly via ACH every Wednesday for the prior week (Monday–Sunday). Advertising Fund Fee is currently 1% of Net Sales but may be increased up to 2% upon 30 days written notice. Technology Fee ranges $80–$400/month depending on services. Transfer Fee is $2,500–$20,000 depending on transfer type. Renewal Fee is 25% of the then-current Initial Franchise Fee. Relocation Fee is actual expenses up to $5,000. Additional training is $1,500 per student beyond the first 3 included. Hours Violation Fee is $100/day. Default Interest is 1.5%/month. Document Late Charge is $100/week per late document. Draft Draw Charge is $100 per returned draft. Interim Operating Fee is 8% of Net Sales plus reasonable expenses.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fees (2) 5% of Net Sales Weekly on every Wednesday for Royalty Fees due for the previous week. (3) Payable by ACH. A week for the payment of Royalty Fees is Monday through Sunday.
Advertising Fund Fee (3) Up to 2% of Net Sales although this fee is currently 1% of Net Sales Weekly on every Wednesday for Advertising Fund Fees due for the previous week (3). Shall be paid at same time and in the same manner as your Royalty Fees. Payable by ACH. We may increase the Advertising Fund Fee upon 30 days written notice to you.
Transfer Fee (4) $2,500-$20,000 At closing of the transfer.
Renewal Fee (5) Twenty-five percent (25%) of the initial franchise fee then being charged for new franchisees Upon your delivery of written notice to us of your intent to renew your Franchise Agreement.
Relocation Fee (6) Actual expenses incurred up to $5,000 Upon delivery of your written request to relocate your Franchised Business.
Additional Initial Training Fee (7) $1,500 per student Upon registration for the Training System of anyone beyond the three (3) individuals included with your Initial Franchise Fee.
Hours Violation Fee $100 per day that you are not open the required number of hours.
Continuing Training, Annual & Other Meetings (8) As incurred.
Alternative Supplier Evaluation Fee The reasonable cost of the inspection and the actual cost of the evaluation not to exceed $5,000.
Technology Fee $80-$400/month As invoiced by our third party providers or Us.
On-site Consultation Fee Our reasonable travel and living expenses plus $250 per day.
Default Interest (9) 1.5% per month on all unpaid amounts.
Document Late Charge (10) $100 per week per late document.
Draft Draw Charge (11) $100 per returned draft.
Audit Our costs, fees, and expenses if the audit reveals an understatement.
Interim Operating Fee Eight percent (8%) of Net Sales plus our reasonable expenses.
Premiums and Other Amounts Paid by us if You Fail to Purchase Required Insurance Varies.
Attorneys' Fees and Costs (12) Varies.
Indemnification of us Varies.
Currency (13) Any conversion fees that we incur.
Taxes Varies.
